Venue: Gate
Headline: CandyDrop 191st: CandyDrop x ValueX (VLX) , Trade and Invite Friends to Share 227,273 VLX

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
CandyDrop is Gate’s candy airdrop platform where users complete tasks to earn candies and share token airdrops. We are excited to launch the VLX token airdrop event, where you can complete the following tasks to earn candies and share a total prize pool of 227,273 VLX, with a maximum individual share of 800 VLX.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 9, 2026, 7:00 – November 19, 2026, 7:00 (UTC)
## 1.Spot Trade Prize Pool Rules
Users spot trade on Gate, with VLX, achieving a spot trading volume (buy + sell) ≥ 1,000 USDT, will earn 1 candy. The total reward pool is 170,000 VLX. Maximum per user: 600 VLX. The reward rule is as follows:
Volume of spot trade ≥ 1,000 USDT: 1 Candy
Volume of spot trade ≥ 3,000 USDT: 3 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 5,000 USDT: 5 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 7,000 USDT: 10 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 10,000 USDT: 15 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 20,000 USDT: 30 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 30,000 USDT: 50 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 50,000 USDT: 80 Candies
## 2.Invite Friends Prize Pool Rules
During the event, for every successful invitation of 1 valid friend (who registers and completes ≥ 500 USDT VLX spot trading), you can receive 1 Candy, with a maximum of 10 Candies. All Candy holders will share a prize pool of 57,273 VLX, with a maximum reward of 200 VLX per person.
Note: To qualify as a valid referral, users must register through the exclusive event link and complete ≥500 USDT in spot trading of VLX. Referrals who have participated in other invitation campaigns will not be eligible for candy rewards at this event.
## Project Introduction
ValueX (VLX) is a next-generation, EVM-compatible blockchain infrastructure built on Avalanche, explicitly designed to power the Web3 carbon economy. It provides a dedicated ecosystem for transparent measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) of carbon credits. From maritime shipping and reforestation to renewable energy, ValueX seamlessly connects real-world environmental impact with on-chain transparency. With its dedicated "ValueX Chain," the platform ensures low, predictable transaction fees for IoT data commits and point accruals, while sub-second finality enables scalable applications. VLX bridges decentralized finance and regenerative sustainability
Token : VLX
Official Website: https://scan.valuex-foundation.com/
X: https://x.com/valuexchain
## Notes
Participants must click the “Join Now” button on the event page. After successfully joining the event, they must complete the event tasks and identity verification to receive rewards.
Rewards will be distributed to users’ accounts within 14 working days after the end of the event.
It is strictly prohibited to register multiple small accounts, engage in malicious wash trading, self-buying and self-selling, or any other cheating behavior. Multiple accounts of the same verified user will be considered the same account. Sub-accounts are not allowed to participate in activities.
Market makers, enterprises, and institutions are not allowed to participate in this event. Agent accounts cannot participate in friend-invitation type activities, while other activities are unrestricted.
In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
Gate has the final interpretation rights for this event.
Users in restricted areas cannot access all or part of the services (including participating in this event, game, or competition). For more information about restricted areas, please read User Agreement.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate ETF Boosted Rewards: Trade to Earn, Boost Your Points & Unlock Up to 550 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
The Gate ETF Boosted Rewards is now live. During the campaign, trade designated ETFs for up to 50 USDT in stackable rewards and unlock up to 3x points on other ETFs. Together, unlock a prize pool of up to 50,000 USDT, shared based on final points. Earn up to 550 USDT per user across both activities.
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 6, 2026, 8:00 – November 15, 2026, 8:00 (UTC)
## Activity 1: Trade to Earn & Boost
During the campaign, as your cumulative trading volume in designated ETFs reaches each milestone, earn tier rewards and unlock higher points boosts for other ETFs—up to 50 USDT in rewards and 3x points.
Designated ETFs: KORU3L/3S, SNXX3L/3S, MUU3L/3S, SOXL3L/3S, SOXS3L/3S. Valid trading volume across these pairs is combined.
Earn 1 base point per 1,000 USDT traded in any ETF. Designated ETF points remain at 1x. At campaign end, your highest unlocked points boost applies to all non-designated ETF base points earned throughout the campaign. Boosts do not stack; the default is 1x.
Final Points = Designated ETF Base Points + Non-Designated ETF Base Points × Unlocked Points Boost
Designated ETF Trading Volume | Reward | Points Boost
≥ 10,000 USDT | 5 USDT | 1.5x
≥ 30,000 USDT | 10 USDT | 2x
≥ 60,000 USDT | 15 USDT | 2.5x
≥ 100,000 USDT | 20 USDT | 3x
## Activity 2: Unlock Tiered Prize Pools
During the campaign, as all participants’ combined ETF trading volume reaches each milestone, unlock larger prize pools, up to 50,000 USDT.
The final prize pool is determined by the highest tier reached at campaign end. Pools do not stack.
Eligible users share the pool based on their proportion of total final points, subject to the corresponding individual reward cap. Only actual valid trading volume counts; points boosts do not affect volume calculations.
Total ETF Trading Volume | Unlocked Prize Pool | Max Reward per User
≥ 50,000,000 USDT | 10,000 USDT | 100 USDT
≥ 60,000,000 USDT | 20,000 USDT | 200 USDT
≥ 75,000,000 USDT | 35,000 USDT | 350 USDT
≥ 90,000,000 USDT | 50,000 USDT | 500 USDT
## Notes
Participants must click the "Join Now" button on the event page to register and complete identity verification to qualify for rewards.
During the event, users must select ETF trading pairs to trade. Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume.
All campaign rewards will be credited to users’ accounts within 14 business days after the campaign ends.
Batch registration of multiple accounts, malicious wash trading, self-trading, or collusive trading is strictly prohibited. Multiple accounts under the same verified identity will be treated as a single account. Sub-accounts are not eligible.
In case of discrepancies between translated versions and the English version, the English version shall prevail. Gate reserves the final interpretation right of this event.
Users from the UK and other restricted regions may be unable to use part or all of the services (including participating in this event, games, or competitions). For detailed restricted region information, please refer to the User Agreement.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Square Comment Challenge: First-Comment Rewards & a 20,000 USDT Weekly Pool

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
## When a post resonates, do you leave a like and scroll on, or jump into the comments?
Have a view to add, a question to ask, or the perfect reply to a meme? This time, leave it in the comments. You bring the conversation; Gate Square spots the standout replies.
Start commenting: Register and leave your first valid comment to receive a 10 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Keep coming back: Accumulate qualifying days each round to earn up to a 100 USDT Futures Position Voucher, with more rewards on the leaderboard
Make your words count: Standout comments could also win USDT
## Campaign Period: November 3, 2026, 02:00 – November 16, 2026, 14:00 (UTC)
## Activity 1: First-Comment Reward: Get 10 USDT for Your First Valid Comment
After registering, leave your first valid comment on another user’s post on Gate Square to receive a 10 USDT Futures Position Voucher.
Both new and existing users are eligible. “First comment” means your first valid comment after registering for this campaign, not your account’s first-ever comment. Each user can receive this reward once during the campaign. Eligible comments also count toward other activities.
## Activity 2: Comment Check-In Rewards: Stay Active, Climb the Leaderboard
After registering, leave at least one valid comment on each of 3 different posts by other users per calendar day to earn a qualifying day. Reach at least 3 qualifying days per weekly round to be eligible for rewards and leaderboard ranking.
More qualifying days mean a higher rank. If days are tied, more valid comments put you ahead. Share your views, ask follow-up questions, and respond to others to climb the leaderboard through meaningful conversations.
Reward Tier | Eligibility Within the Round | Reward
1st Place | At least 3 qualifying days and 1st on the weekly leaderboard | 1 Gate merchandise gift, valued at approximately 150 USDT
2nd Place | At least 3 qualifying days and 2nd on the weekly leaderboard | 100 USDT Futures Position Voucher
3rd Place | At least 3 qualifying days and 3rd on the weekly leaderboard | 50 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Milestone Reward | 7 qualifying days | 40 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Milestone Reward | 5 qualifying days | 30 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Milestone Reward | 3 qualifying days | 20 USDT Futures Position Voucher
The top three users receive their ranking reward. Other qualifying users receive the milestone reward corresponding to their qualifying days.
## Participation and Ranking Rules
Keep coming back: Qualifying days accumulate within each round and do not need to be consecutive. Each calendar day counts as a maximum of one qualifying day.
Engage to climb: Rankings are based first on qualifying days, then on total valid comments within the round. If both are tied, whoever reached that number of qualifying days first ranks higher.
Keep the conversation going: Multiple substantive comments and replies under the same post can count toward your valid comment total. Each post counts only once toward the daily three-post requirement.
Start fresh each week: Each weekly round is calculated separately. Rewards are issued after review based on your ranking or milestone tier. You can participate again the following week.
## Activity 3: Community Voice Awards: Standout Comments Win 5 USDT
After registering, leave valid comments or replies on other users’ posts to enter the selection. No separate submission or completion of check-in tasks is required.
## Each round, 3 users with outstanding comments will be selected to receive 5 USDT each.
Selection focuses on relevance, specific insights, and original, natural expression. Helpful information, relatable trading experiences, thoughtful questions, and well-placed humor are all welcome.
There is no minimum like count, and comment length does not determine quality. Likes are considered for reference only and do not directly determine winners.
Each user can receive this reward once per round and may participate again with new comments in the next round. Winning comments will be showcased alongside brief reasons for their selection.
## Activity 4: Surprise Comment Rewards: Great Posts Deserve Great Replies
Gate Square will periodically feature quality posts on selected topics and open limited-time comment discussions.
Registered users who participate within the designated period will be considered based on their comments’ relevance, quality of expression, and contribution to the discussion. Each selected user receives 5 USDT.
The number of winners, participation period, and designated posts will be announced separately for each session.
## Terms and Conditions
Only valid comments posted after registration and during the campaign period count. Comments on your own posts or replies to your own comments are excluded.
Valid comments must be written by you, relate to the original post, and include a specific view, experience, question, or substantive response. Comments sent using the “One-Click Comment” feature are not valid for this campaign. Copy-pasted content, repetitive spam, emoji-only comments, meaningless replies, and ads are also excluded.
You may participate in all four activities and receive rewards across different activities. A comment that meets multiple requirements may count toward the corresponding tasks or selections.
Comments that have been deleted or removed for violations by the time of review will not count. Cheating, including multi-account participation, bulk comment spam, or manipulated likes, will result in disqualification from the relevant rewards.
Rewards will be distributed after review. Winner lists and distribution arrangements will be announced on the campaign page or through official accounts. Merchandise details, claiming instructions, and shipping requirements will be provided in the winner notification.
Futures Position Vouchers are not equivalent to USDT cash. Usage, validity, and other conditions are subject to the terms shown on each voucher.
All campaign rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the campaign ends.
